public_site.purpose: Federation public home: news, rules, players, tournaments snapshots, and how to get started. Live rankings-style data may appear when the API feed is available.

pro_billiards_software.name: Pro Billiards Software
pro_billiards_software.role: Official app engine USPBF runs: sign in, self-service registration (non-pros), event registration, brackets, live scoring, rankings, head-to-head, player performance, AI Coach, and ALFa AI inside the app.

alfa_on_uspbf.note: This chat on example.com is a limited public demo of ALFa. It explains USPBF, account types, and Pro Billiards Software tiers/deals from published materials. It cannot access private player stats or signed-in data.

professional_wpa.summary: Pro accounts are provisioned from WPA license data by tournament directors or USPBF admins — not via the public self-registration form.
professional_wpa.sign_in: Use credentials provided by your tournament director or USPBF at probilliardssoftware.com.
professional_wpa.if_no_account: Contact your director or USPBF; do not use public self-registration if you already have a WPA license.

top_level_amateur.summary: May self-register at Pro Billiards Software. Tournament results and rankings tracking apply when directors/federation designate eligibility (e.g. director-verified or association criteria).
top_level_amateur.license_field: Optional association license number at registration can help link an existing player record.

other_players_handicap.summary: May create an account and use site features and open events. Handicap-based divisions and full rankings for lower bands are still rolling out; messaging on the site explains current limits.

account_types.email_verification: New self-registered users must verify email before signing in.

rules_and_formats.coverage: USPBF covers men and women, pro and elite amateurs, major game types, and popular rule sets including WPBA, WPA, Heyball, and artistic pool where adopted for sanctioned events.
rules_and_formats.starting_point: Rules pages on example.com reference WPA/WPBA published rules; variants are labeled when used.

ratings_and_integrity_messaging.summary: Public messaging describes ALFa as an AI-assisted ratings approach designed to improve on legacy single-number systems, with anti-cheat and live checks in the product roadmap; exact feature availability is described in-app and in federation materials.
ratings_and_integrity_messaging.disclaimer: Do not invent specific player ratings, match results, or unpublished product release dates — steer users to the live app or official announcements.
